hItems.title: Sydney Swans
hItems.description: Played at least 1 game for the Sydney Swans, or currently on their list. Includes players who played at least 1 game for South Melbourne.

hItems.title: SCG
hItems.subtitle: KICKED A GOAL
hItems.description: Kicked at least 1 goal at the SGC in a VFL/AFL game.

vItems.title: 2+ PRELIM
vItems.subtitle: FINALS
vItems.description: Played in 2 or more Preliminary Finals.

vItems.title: CHAD WARNER
vItems.subtitle: CHAD WARNER TEAMMATE
vItems.description: Player has been a teammate of Chad Warner.

vItems.title: ALL AUSTRALIAN
vItems.description: Player has made at least one All-Australian team. Includes VFL Team of the Year (1982-90), and All-Australian teams selected after State of Origin carnivals (1953–1988).
